content.title: Blackstone Real Estate to take Retail Opportunity private in $4 billion deal
content.summary: Reuters reported on Sunday that the alternative asset manager was in advanced talks for the acquisition of the company, which owns strip malls across the United States.  Owners of strip malls, pharmacy chains and retail stores have managed to pass on increased costs from high inflation to consumers over the past year, benefiting landlords like ROIC.  The real estate investment trust has raised rents, achieving a 13.8% increase in same-space new leases during the third quarter, according to its most recent quarterly report.

content.title: Exclusive-Blackstone in advanced talks to acquire shopping center owner Retail Opportunity, sources say
content.summary: NEW YORK (Reuters) -Blackstone is in advanced talks to acquire Retail Opportunity Investments Corp, which owns U.S. shopping centers and has a market value of $3.4 billion including debt, according to people familiar with the matter.  Blackstone is likely to prevail in the auction for ROIC that has also attracted interest from other private equity firms, including Bain Capital, the sources said.  Earlier this year, Bain Capital's real estate arm and retail investor 11North Partners had formed a partnership to acquire and operate open-air retail centers in North America.
